extracted.intended_audience: producers, creators, and organizations submitting work to the Peabody Awards (television, streaming, radio, podcast, interactive/immersive creators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural rules for submitting media work to the Peabody Awards and the principles used by Peabody juries to evaluate and select winners across broadcast, streaming, radio, podcast, and interactive/immersive categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award categories and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year, 30 Peabody Awards are given for entertainment, documentary, news, podcast and radio, children’s/youth, and public service programming. Special awards are also given to individuals for career achievement and institutions for their long-standing body of work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2022 Peabody expanded categories to recognize interactive, immersive and new media (including Gaming, Interactive Journalism, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Social Video, Interactive Documentary, Transmedia Storytelling, and more).

rubrics_metrics.name: Core evaluative principle: stories that matter
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no set criteria for judging the winners. Peabody Awards recognize stories that illuminate social issues with depth and complexity as much as stories that entertain and inspire through their art or voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization states broadly: 'We honor stories that matter.' (i.e., emphasis on social illumination, depth/complexity, artistic/voiced inspiration rather than a fixed checklist.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility by production year
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries accepted must be work produced in that calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters should ensure the work's production date falls within the calendar year specified for the submission window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission windows by category
rubrics_metrics.description: Television/streaming/podcast and radio entries: typically accepted annually in the fall, from October to December. Interactive and immersive entries: typically accepted annually (page lists August to October in one place and June to August in another).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations and winners are announced the following spring; the awards ceremony takes place in May/June (typically in New York or Los Angeles). Visit the submission pages for each category for exact dates and instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process and deliberation standard
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection of nominees and winners is based on a rigorous deliberative process and face-to-face discussions among diverse Boards of Jurors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peabody currently has a Broadcast Board and an Interactive Board; both boards are comprised of media professionals, scholars, critics, and journalists and are designed to reflect a broad cross-section of voices, experiences, and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and types of awards (annual limit and special awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Approximately 30 awards are given annually across categories; special awards may be given to individuals (career achievement) and institutions (body of work).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters should be aware that only a limited number of awards are given each year and that there are separate recognitions beyond the standard category awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate and statuette eligibility and ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone credited with working on a Peabody Award-winning program, as well as executives at the company/station/network, are eligible to purchase a statuette with custom engraving. Certificates are available for anyone credited with working on a Peabody Award-nominated program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Orders may be placed at any time. There is no expiration date for program wins or nominations; statuettes can be custom-engraved and purchased via the Peabody store link.
